events.description: A blue mouse runs through grass, then disappears behind foliage. A human figure is visible in a window.
The blue mouse finds a mushroom, approaches a red mouse in a trash can, and offers it. The red mouse emerges and takes the mushroom.
The blue mouse and red mouse walk together. The red mouse warns about their father. The blue mouse shows the red mouse a piece of cheese.
Blue mouse excitedly presents cheese to brown mouse. Brown mouse watches with neutral expression.
Blue mouse excitedly shows herbs and sweet grass juice to brown mouse, who turns away.
Blue mouse declares they must cook. Camera pans up to show stormy sky.
Blue mouse roasts cheese on a rooftop device. Brown mouse watches, then expresses concern about wind.
Two mice stand on a rooftop, one blue, one brown, discussing proximity.
A rooftop antenna explodes, sending sparks into the sky.
Two mice lie on the ground, one holding a stick with a roasted item.
Mice sit up, one holding a roasted item, discussing flavor.
Mice stand near a house, planning to return to the roof.
View from below shows a damaged ceiling with holes and a chandelier above.
A small mouse is on a stove, surrounded by broken glass. A human hand is visible.
Close-up of an elderly woman with glasses, showing a fearful expression.
A black mouse is on a table, reaching out. The woman is blurred in the background.
A hand opens a small cardboard box on a wooden surface.
The elderly woman looks upward with a startled expression.
A small mouse is on a wooden surface, looking toward the viewer.
A pink mouse climbs a lamp, then a black mouse is seen on a chandelier. The woman holds a shotgun and aims at the mice.
Woman in pink pajamas aims shotgun at camera, eyes wide with intent.
Camera tilts up to show ceiling with multiple holes and cracks.
Massive rat swarm bursts through ceiling, filling room with dust and chaos.
Rats swarm through room, climbing furniture and furniture, moving toward exit.
Rats flood out of room, moving in large group toward exterior.
Rats run across floor, some falling, others scrambling toward exit.
Rats rush past kitchen counter, knocking over items, including a cookbook.
Rats exit house through door, scattering into yard.
A mouse looks at a book with a picture of bread and five stars.
A figure in a gas mask appears in a kitchen, surrounded by green smoke.
The mouse runs outside into a rainy, dark landscape, shouting '快～，快～，快～'.
The mouse paddles a boat in a dark tunnel, shouting to 'Remy' and then 'Wait, wait'.
The mouse continues paddling in the tunnel, facing a waterfall ahead.
A small mouse sits on a flat object in a dark, tunnel-like environment. The mouse turns its head slightly between frames.
Two animated rats discuss a food item on a stick, with a house in the background under a cloudy sky.
View from low angle shows damaged ceiling with holes and a chandelier. A blurry red object is in the foreground.
Overhead view of a kitchen stove. A small blue rat is on the stove. A large red rat is partially visible, holding a candle.
Blue mouse holds food, speaks about cooking. Expression shifts to concern.
Mouse gestures with hand while speaking, then begins to move out of frame.
Mouse exits frame. Camera pans up to show house roof and stormy sky.
Object explodes on rooftop, sending sparks into dark sky. Smoke rises from chimney.
Two hedgehogs lie motionless on ground. Dust cloud obscures background. Object falls above them.
